classes.label: Agent
classes.comment: A resource that acts or has the power to act.

classes.label: Agent Class
classes.comment: A group of agents.

classes.label: Bibliographic Resource
classes.comment: A book, article, or other documentary resource.

classes.label: File Format
classes.comment: A digital resource format.

classes.label: Frequency
classes.comment: A rate at which something recurs.

classes.label: Jurisdiction
classes.comment: The extent or range of judicial, law enforcement, or other authority.

classes.label: License Document
classes.comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with a Resource.

classes.label: Linguistic System
classes.comment: A system of signs, symbols, sounds, gestures, or rules used in communication.

classes.label: Location
classes.comment: A spatial region or named place.

classes.label: Location, Period, or Jurisdiction
classes.comment: A location, period of time, or jurisdiction.

classes.label: Media Type
classes.comment: A file format or physical medium.

classes.label: Media Type or Extent
classes.comment: A media type or extent.

classes.label: Method of Instruction
classes.comment: A process that is used to engender knowledge, attitudes, and skills.

classes.label: Method of Accrual
classes.comment: A method by which resources are added to a collection.

classes.label: Period of Time
classes.comment: An interval of time that is named or defined by its start and end dates.

classes.label: Physical Medium
classes.comment: A physical material or carrier.

classes.label: Physical Resource
classes.comment: A material thing.

classes.label: Policy
classes.comment: A plan or course of action by an authority, intended to influence and determine decisions, actions, and other matters.

classes.label: Provenance Statement
classes.comment: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of a resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

classes.label: Rights Statement
classes.comment: A statement about the intellectual property rights (IPR) held in or over a Resource, a legal document giving official permission to do something with a resource, or a statement about access rights.

classes.label: Size or Duration
classes.comment: A dimension or extent, or a time taken to play or execute.

classes.label: Standard
classes.comment: A basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated.

properties.label: Title
properties.comment: A name given to the resource.

properties.label: Creator
properties.comment: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource.

properties.label: Subject
properties.comment: The topic of the resource.

properties.label: Description
properties.comment: An account of the resource.

properties.label: Publisher
properties.comment: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

properties.label: Contributor
properties.comment: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.

properties.label: Date
properties.comment: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource.

properties.label: Type
properties.comment: The nature or genre of the resource.

properties.label: Format
properties.comment: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

properties.label: Identifier
properties.comment: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

properties.label: Source
properties.comment: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

properties.label: Language
properties.comment: A language of the resource.

properties.label: Relation
properties.comment: A related resource.

properties.label: Coverage
properties.comment: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, the spatial applicability of the resource, or the jurisdiction under which the resource is relevant.

properties.label: Rights
properties.comment: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

properties.label: Audience
properties.comment: A class of entity for whom the resource is intended or useful.

properties.label: Alternative Title
properties.comment: An alternative name for the resource.

properties.label: Table Of Contents
properties.comment: A list of subunits of the resource.

properties.label: Abstract
properties.comment: A summary of the resource.

properties.label: Date Created
properties.comment: Date of creation of the resource.

properties.label: Date Valid
properties.comment: Date (often a range) of validity of a resource.

properties.label: Date Available
properties.comment: Date (often a range) that the resource became or will become available.

properties.label: Date Issued
properties.comment: Date of formal issuance (e.g., publication) of the resource.

properties.label: Date Modified
properties.comment: Date on which the resource was changed.

properties.label: Extent
properties.comment: The size or duration of the resource.

properties.label: Medium
properties.comment: The material or physical carrier of the resource.

properties.label: Is Version Of
properties.comment: A related resource of which the described resource is a version, edition, or adaptation.

properties.label: Has Version
properties.comment: A related resource that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described resource.

properties.label: Is Replaced By
properties.comment: A related resource that supplants, displaces, or supersedes the described resource.

properties.label: Replaces
properties.comment: A related resource that is supplanted, displaced, or superseded by the described resource.

properties.label: Is Required By
properties.comment: A related resource that requires the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

properties.label: Requires
properties.comment: A related resource that is required by the described resource to support its function, delivery, or coherence.

properties.label: Is Part Of
properties.comment: A related resource in which the described resource is physically or logically included.

properties.label: Has Part
properties.comment: A related resource that is included either physically or logically in the described resource.

properties.label: Is Referenced By
properties.comment: A related resource that references, cites, or otherwise points to the described resource.

properties.label: References
properties.comment: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.

properties.label: Is Format Of
properties.comment: A related resource that is substantially the same as the described resource, but in another format.

properties.label: Has Format
properties.comment: A related resource that is substantially the same as the pre-existing described resource, but in another format.

properties.label: Conforms To
properties.comment: An established standard to which the described resource conforms.

properties.label: Spatial Coverage
properties.comment: Spatial characteristics of the resource.

properties.label: Temporal Coverage
properties.comment: Temporal characteristics of the resource.

properties.label: Mediator
properties.comment: An entity that mediates access to the resource and for whom the resource is intended or useful.

properties.label: Date Accepted
properties.comment: Date of acceptance of the resource.

properties.label: Date Copyrighted
properties.comment: Date of copyright.

properties.label: Date Submitted
properties.comment: Date of submission of the resource.

properties.label: Audience Education Level
properties.comment: A class of entity, defined in terms of progression through an educational or training context, for which the described resource is intended.

properties.label: Access Rights
properties.comment: Information about who can access the resource or an indication of its security status.

properties.label: Bibliographic Citation
properties.comment: A bibliographic reference for the resource.

properties.label: License
properties.comment: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

properties.label: Rights Holder
properties.comment: A person or organization owning or managing rights over the resource.

properties.label: Provenance
properties.comment: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation that are significant for its authenticity, integrity, and interpretation.

properties.label: Instructional Method
properties.comment: A process, used to engender knowledge, attitudes and skills, that the described resource is designed to support.

properties.label: Accrual Method
properties.comment: The method by which items are added to a collection.

properties.label: Accrual Periodicity
properties.comment: The frequency with which items are added to a collection.

properties.label: Accrual Policy
properties.comment: The policy governing the addition of items to a collection.
